definitions.stratified: top fraction versus the rest computed separately inside each size-band x vertical stratum then pooled, so the comparison does not just reward being a bigger campaign in a bigger vertical
definitions.raw_unmatched: the same top fraction versus rest with no stratification, for comparison; a feature ratio that is large here and close to 1 in stratified is explained by size and vertical, not the feature
definitions.vertical: homepage-label industry folded into the ten vertical names the giveaway skills use
definitions.band: 3 native contestant bands on the 1,000+ frame: 1k-2.5k, 2.5k-10k, 10k+
definitions.value_index: campaign contestants divided by the median contestants of the campaign's stated-USD prize value band, valued campaigns only
definitions.clean: no repeatable action and 14 days or less, the subset conversion is safe to compare across

entrants.definition: top 20% of valid_contestants, stratified by vertical only since size band would make this circular

clean_conversion.definition: clean subset only, stratified by band and vertical

email_yield_per_contestant.definition: campaigns running an email action only, stratified by band and vertical

referral_yield_per_contestant.definition: campaigns running the referral share action only, stratified by band and vertical

social_yield_per_contestant.definition: campaigns running at least one social action only, stratified by band and vertical

prize_value_adjusted_performance.definition: valued campaigns only, stratified by vertical since value band is already adjusted for

cost_per_contestant.definition: valued campaigns only, lower cost is the top of this cohort, stratified by band and vertical

prize_category_by_industry.definition: value index by prize category crossed with organizer industry, valued campaigns

prize_value_by_industry.definition: contestants by stated-USD prize value band crossed with organizer industry, valued campaigns

prize_value_by_winner_count.definition: contestants by stated-USD prize value band crossed with winner count band (sum of prize units), valued campaigns

duration_by_industry.definition: clean conversion by duration band crossed with organizer industry

duration_by_campaign_type.definition: clean conversion by duration band crossed with a title or description campaign type (a campaign can carry several types)

entry_method_by_industry.definition: clean conversion by entry-method family crossed with organizer industry (a campaign can carry several families)

entry_method_by_prize_type.definition: clean conversion by entry-method family crossed with prize category

referral_action_by_campaign_size.definition: entries per entrant by whether the campaign runs a referral share action crossed with contestant band

action_count_by_conversion_and_band.definition: clean conversion by action-count band crossed with contestant band, to see whether the action-count relationship holds or shifts across bands

action_count_by_engagement_and_band.definition: entries per entrant by action-count band crossed with contestant band

organizer_experience_by_performance_and_.definition: clean conversion by organizer sequence band (1st, 2nd-5th, 6th-20th, 21st+ campaign on the dataset by that site, all campaigns not just ordinary) crossed with contestant band

traffic_source_by_engagement_and_band.definition: entries per entrant by the plurality traffic channel (40% or more of impressions) crossed with contestant band

holiday_by_campaign_type.definition: contestants by named holiday theme crossed with campaign type

interactions_definitions.interaction_ratio: cell median divided by what the row's main effect times the column's main effect would predict on its own (both as a ratio to the grand median), on the raw scale; 1.0 means the two variables explain the cell without needing each other, further from 1.0 in either direction is a genuine interaction
interactions_definitions.not_tested: requested pairs where no cell reached the 30-campaign, 10-organizer floor are listed with an empty cells object and a note
